units: ratio of latest expectation to initial guidance
instructions: How far the company's expectation for its annual production has moved from the first guidance it gave for that year. Choose the fiscal year: the latest fiscal year for which the company has given full-year production guidance in a document visible on the date. Initial guidance is the first full-year production figure or range for that year in any visible document (often the earnings release for the prior fourth quarter, sometimes an earlier preliminary outlook). Latest expectation is the company's reported actual production for the full year once it has been reported; until then, the midpoint of the most recent full-year production guidance for that year. The value is latest expectation divided by initial guidance, so it starts at 1.0 when guidance is first given. Guidance is a stated figure or range for full-year production, or a stated numeric change from the prior year ('up 5%', 'up 3% to 5%', or 'flat', which is no change). A statement without a number or range, such as 'similar to last year' or 'modest growth', is not guidance. Use the midpoint of a range, a point estimate as given, and an approximate figure as stated. Use total net production in barrels of oil equivalent per day, or in the gas-equivalent unit the company uses, and the same measure throughout the year. If the company guides only oil production, use oil. Never mix measures between initial guidance and latest expectation. If guidance is given only relative to a prior year ('flat to up 5%'), convert it using the prior-year actual the company reported. If the company revised guidance to include an acquisition or divestiture that closed during the year, use guidance it gives on its original asset base. If it gives none, but states the transaction's expected contribution to full-year production, subtract an acquisition's contribution from the revised guidance, or add a divestiture's back, and say so in the text. If it states neither, the value is null for the rest of that year; say so in the text. Read earnings releases, the presentations furnished with them, 10-Qs and the 10-K. Set period to the fiscal year, as 'FY2024'. Null when the company has given no full-year production guidance in any visible document; name in the text the documents read. In the text, state both figures, their documents and dates, and the measure used.
